title: feat(record-page): each changed field is its own line under an activity entry, old → new
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9NRmimMwnUgR1DbqgHtBWM3)_

Part of #36290

Clause-②: yes (widening) — four new `detail.*` language-pack keys in every locale `@object-ui/i18n` ships, and new optional props on the exported `FieldChangeItem`; nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none

PR 2 of 4 on the card (part ②: card items 1 and 2, and the activity half of item 5). PR 1 (#36399, merged as `70194ffc`) made the activity stream serve each changed field's old and new values, narrowed per reader. This PR draws them on the record page. Part ① (the designer producers of `fieldHistory`) waits for #36580; part ③ (the per-field history card and the field and grid-cell entry points) closes the card. Ruling-ref: 7076513167.

## 维护者速读

- 记录页「动态」里，每次保存现在先写改了哪些字段，下面每个字段一行「字段名：旧值 → 新值」；旧值为空写「空」，长文字截成一行，点「展开」看全文；单选显示选项名，关联记录和人员显示名字。
- 属于「记录详情页重做」专题下的字段修改历史：以前动态里只写「更新了 客户备注」，看不到改前改后的值；服务器上周已经按读取权限发送这些值，这次是把它们画出来。
- 出错时，用户会看到动态里的修改行排版不对或展开按钮失灵；不会多看到任何字段，因为没有读取权限的字段服务器本来就不发送；可以整体撤回，数据不受影响。
- 无

## What changes

**The served values reach the timeline** (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts`)
- New `activityFieldChangesOf(row)`: reads the field-change code plugin-audit serves in `sys_activity.metadata` (`summary_message`, key `fieldChanges`) and turns it into one `FieldChangeEntry` per field. `activityRowToFeedItem` puts it on the item as `fieldChanges`. An option side keeps the option it matched; a yes/no side keeps the boolean; the writer's empty mark (`∅`, or an empty text) becomes an empty side. A code it cannot read whole gives nothing, and the row draws its summary as before.
- Nothing is filtered in the browser. The server already drops a change of a field the reader may not read, and a reference change whose record title the reader is not served (PR 1, `activity-field-redaction.ts`). The timeline draws exactly the changes it is handed.

**One line per changed field** (`RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`, `FieldChangeItem.tsx`)
- An entry with changes (an activity row's served code, an audit-log entry, or the audit entry paired onto an activity row) draws its usual one-line row, then one line per changed field under it: `Label: old → new`.
- The row's own text: for an entry whose changes are its own, `Updated Phone, Email` (its stored summary would repeat the lines). An activity row carrying its paired audit entry keeps its own summary. The record's creation is unchanged (one row, values beside the summary).
- Each side: an option reads as the field's option label in the reader's language (`fieldOptionLabel`, falling back to the schema label, then the served text); a lookup or user reads as the record name the server served; a yes/no reads as `common.yes` / `common.no`; an empty side as `detail.fieldChangeEmpty`.
- Each side is cut to its line (`truncate`). A side that overflows (measured), holds a line break, or is longer than 48 characters offers `Show all`, which wraps both sides in full, and `Show less`.
- The row's markers (`data-stream-row`, `data-stream-system-row`) sit on the whole entry (the line plus its field lines), so a reader of the row reads both; the 30 px line is `data-stream-line`.
- The compact one-line change text (the activity panel's peek rows, the creation row's diff) now uses the same label, words and empty word: `Status: New → Contacted`, where it read `Status New → Contacted` with `—` for empty.
- `FieldChangeItem` (exported, previously unused) is the line: new optional `label`, `oldText` / `newText`, `emptyLabel`, `expandLabel` / `collapseLabel`; with none of them it draws as before except the arrow is text and the empty word defaults to `(empty)`.

**Language packs** (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, 11 locales; `useDetailTranslation.ts` defaults mirror `en`)
- `detail.fieldChangeLabel` (`{{field}}:`; fullwidth colon in zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja; `{{field}} :` in fr), `detail.fieldChangeEmpty` (`Empty`, `空`), `detail.fieldChangeExpand` (`Show all`, `展开`), `detail.fieldChangeCollapse` (`Show less`, `收起`).

## Tests

New pins, as top-level describes in the existing harness files:
- `renderers/__tests__/record-activity.test.tsx` — `record:activity — one line per changed field, old → new (objectstack#36290)`: one field (`Customer notes: Old words → New words`); phone and email in one save is ONE row with two lines; empty side reads `Empty`, never `∅`; select, lookup, user and yes/no read as option label, record names and words; only the served changes draw (a field left out of the code has no line); a long value truncates and toggles; the stream fold opens to each save's own lines; CONTROL: a short value has no toggle, and a row with no code draws its summary.
- `renderers/__tests__/recordActivityFeed.test.ts` — `activityFieldChangesOf`: mapping of text, option, boolean and the empty mark; the item carries the changes beside its summary; no code, another code, an empty or unreadable code give nothing.

Forced test changes (each because the line format moved from `Label old → new` on one element to `Label: old → new` drawn over several elements):
- `__tests__/recordTimelineStream-27055.test.tsx`: a `changeLines()` reader over `[data-field-change]`; the six `getByText(/… → …/)` matches read it instead (a text matcher cannot see a line split over spans). The negative `queryByText(/New → Contacted/)` was moved too, since it would have become vacuous. The two creation-diff strings gain the colon.
- `__tests__/RecordTimelinePanel-27524.test.tsx`: the peek line reads `Status: New → Contacted`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx`: the audit-date and currency diff readers read `[data-field-change]` lines, and their expected strings gain the colon (`Close date: 3.3.2020 → 4.3.2020`, `Amount: €1,500.00 → €2,500.00`). The values themselves are unchanged.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts`: `detail.fieldChangeLabel` joins `LEGITIMATE_IDENTITIES` as a format string (ko/ru/ar keep `:`), like `grid.summary.pattern`.

The permission half is the server's, pinned by PR 1 in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/activity-field-redaction.test.ts` (`[#36290] masked: …`, `[#36290] not served: the code and the summary are served without the change of the field not served`, `[#36290] control: a reader served every field is served the whole code`). This PR adds the UI side: the timeline draws only what is served.

## Acceptance notes

- Card lines, as this PR covers them: 「改一条客户的「客户备注」并保存：动态里出现「客户备注：旧文字 → 新文字」。」 — yes (zh-Hans label template `{{field}}：`). 「一次保存同时改电话和邮箱：一条动态，下面两行。」 — yes. 「单选、关联记录、人员字段：前后值显示的是选项名和记录名，不是内部编号。」 — yes for single select, lookup and user (option label read per reader; record names as served). 「用一个没有某字段读取权限的账号：动态里没有那个字段的修改行」 — the server leaves the change out (PR 1); the UI draws what is served. The 「修改历史」 half of that line is part ③.
- Screenshots of the activity: NOT MEASURED in this PR (no local backend and console build in this run). To reproduce: `OS_PORT=3000 pnpm dev`, open a showcase record, edit a long text field and, in one save, two short fields; the record's 动态 tab shows one entry per save with one line per field; a long value shows `Show all`.
- The empty side is recognised by the writer's text `∅` (or an empty text), the notation plugin-audit's `summaryValueOf` writes and its tests pin; the served code carries no separate empty mark. A structural mark would be a server change, outside this PR.
- Multi-select and `tree` sides still read as the stored text the writer wrote (PR 1 nits, not taken there either).
- Docs: `ui/AGENTS.md` #2 asks for the package README and the `content/docs/frontend/` page; both are outside this dispatch's file surface, so neither is edited here.
- No change to which entries the activity shows, how consecutive edits fold, the activity filters, or audit storage.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts` — `activityFieldChangesOf` (the only new read of server data; the empty mark).
2. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` — `fieldChangeLinesOf`, `changeSideText`, and `renderSystemLine` (which entries get lines, and the row-marker move in `streamRow`).
3. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/FieldChangeItem.tsx` — truncation, the measured overflow and the toggle.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-activity.test.tsx` — expect 35 passed, among them the eight `one line per changed field` tests.

Readings below are at head `f281417b` (after merging `origin/main` once).

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/ packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack.test.tsx` plus the 22 app-shell `RecordDetailView.*` / record-page activity test files, at `f281417b`: `Test Files 543 passed | 1 skipped (544)`, `Tests 6159 passed | 31 skipped (6190)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
